description: Recurso Eólico de Canarias is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by idecan1.grafcan.es. WMS of the Canary Islands Wind Resource that has been prepared by the Technological Institute of the Canary Islands (ITC) and describes the main characteristics of the existing wind (speed, direction and other parameters) for specific coordinates of points of the Canary Islands archipelago. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "WMS Canary Islands Wind Resource" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
